# Ek Khirki, Ek Masoom Bacha Aur Society Ki 5 Karwi Haqeeqatein
### Ek haqeeqi waqia jisne mujhe insani psychology, darr, society aur himmat ke baare mein sochne par majboor kar diya.

**Kabhi kabhi zindagi humein woh sabaq chand minutes mein sikha deti hai, jo shayad kitaabein parhne ke baad bhi samajh nahi aate.**

Aaj mere saath bhi kuch aisa hi hua.

Main college mein tha. Ek normal din tha aur hamara lecture khatam hone hi wala tha. Hum apni class mein baithe hue the, jo college ki second floor par thi.

Achanak hamari class ke ek larkay ne by chance khirki se bahar dekha.

Usne kuch aisa dekha jis par woh khud bhi hairaan reh gaya aur humein bhi kehne laga:

**"Woh dekho! Woh aadmi us bachay ke saath kya kar raha hai?"**

Hum sab hairaan hue ke aakhir bahar aisa kya ho raha hai.

Jab humne khirki se neeche dekha toh ek aadmi ek chhote se bachay ko maar raha tha.

Bachay ki umar taqreeban 3 se 4 saal hogi.

Shuru mein humein laga ke shayad woh aadmi bachay ke saath mazaaq kar raha hai, ya use kisi baat par samjha raha hai. Kyunke pehle woh itni sakhti se nahi maar raha tha.

Lekin chand hi lamhon mein humein ehsaas ho gaya ke ye koi mazaaq nahi tha.

**Woh aadmi waqai us masoom bachay par tashaddud kar raha tha.**

Humne apni teacher ko bhi bataya. Woh female teacher thi.

Lekin unka reaction dekh kar main hairaan reh gaya.

Unhone is baat ko kuch aise ignore kiya, jaise koi insaan raaste mein chalte hue ek pathar ko nazarandaaz kar deta hai.

Na koi khaas reaction, na koi serious response.

Aur yahin se maine ek aur cheez observe karni shuru kar di.

Main sirf neeche hone wale waqiye ko nahi dekh raha tha.

**Main apni class mein maujood har insaan ka reaction bhi observe kar raha tha.**

Kuch students ne is waqiye ko ignore kar diya.

Kuch us aadmi ko bura bhala keh rahe the.

Kuch ko bohot gussa aa raha tha.

Aur kuch students mujhe aise lage jaise woh us bachay ki madad ke liye bahar jaana chahte hon, lekin college ki boundary aur rules unhein rok rahe hon.

Phir achanak kuch aisa hua jisne poori situation badal di.

### Woh Teen Thappar...

Us aadmi ne bachay ke chehre ki right side par ek zor daar thappar maara.

Phir left side par do thappar maare.

Aur jab usne teesra thappar maara, toh woh chhota sa bacha kuch door ja kar neeche mitti mein gir gaya.

Ye manzar dekh kar hamari class mein maujood ek larkay se bardasht nahi hua.

Woh foran apni jagah se utha.

Usne apne saath baithe larkay ko bhi uthaya aur ghusse mein kaha:

**"Iski jurrat kaise hui itne masoom bachay ko maarne ki?"**

Phir woh dono neeche chale gaye.

Kisi teacher se permission nahi li.

Kisi se ye nahi poocha ke college se bahar ja sakte hain ya nahi.

Woh college ke peechay wale darwaze se bahar nikal gaye.

Main bhi unke saath jaana chahta tha.

Lekin...

Main ruk gaya.

Kyun?

**Darr ki wajah se.**

Mere zehan mein ye baat thi ke bina permission college ki boundary cross karna rules ke khilaaf hai.

Agar teacher ne dekh liya toh?

Agar punishment mili toh?

Ye soch kar main thora peechay hat gaya.

Lekin jab woh dono bahar chale gaye, toh mujhse bhi control nahi hua.

Aur phir main bhi bina permission college se bahar chala gaya.

### College Ke Bahar Kya Hua?

Jab hum bahar gaye toh woh chhota sa bacha abhi bhi ro raha tha.

Woh dara hua tha aur kuch bol nahi raha tha.

Jo aadmi use maar raha tha, woh khud ko us bachay ka baap keh raha tha.

Lekin humein us par poora yaqeen nahi aa raha tha.

Sawal ye tha ke kya woh waqai uska baap tha?

Hamare saath jo larka sabse pehle bahar aaya tha, usne bachay ko utha liya aur us aadmi se baat ki.

Usne poocha ke aapka ghar kahan hai.

Us aadmi ne kaha ke woh yahin ka rehne wala hai.

Pehle toh humein uski baat par yaqeen nahi aaya.

Phir usne kaha ke kuch log use jaante hain.

Usi waqt bike par do log aaye, jinhon ne us aadmi ko pehchaan liya.

Lekin iske bawajood hum ye confirm nahi kar sake ke woh waqai bachay ka baap tha ya koi aur.

Isi dauran college ka watchman ya security guard darwaze se humein awaaz de raha tha:

**"Andar aa jao, sir bula rahe hain!"**

Hum wapas college mein enter hue aur apne lecture mein ja kar baith gaye.

Kisi ne humein kuch khaas nahi kaha.

Lekin class ke students pooch rahe the ke bahar kya hua.

Isi dauran ek larkay ne poocha:

**"Sir ne daanta toh nahi?"**

Uska ye sawaal sun kar mujhe gussa aaya.

Maine jawab diya:

"Nahi, woh kyun daantenge?"

Lekin mere gusse ki asal wajah kuch aur thi.

Main soch raha tha ke abhi hum ek chhote se bachay ko itni buri tarah pitte hue dekh kar aaye hain, aur is larkay ki sabse pehli fikr ye hai ke sir ne daanta toh nahi?

Us waqt mujhe uski soch mein maturity ki kami mehsoos hui.

Mujhe laga ke shayad woh doosron ke reactions aur authority ke darr se apne decisions leta hai.

Lekin is poore incident ke baad main bohot dair tak sochta raha.

Aur dheere dheere mujhe samajh aaya ke...

**Aaj maine sirf ek bachay par hota hua zulm nahi dekha tha, balki insani psychology aur society ki kuch aisi realities bhi dekhi thin jo hamari rozmarra ki zindagi mein har jagah maujood hain.**

---

# Reality No. 1: Log Zulm Dekh Kar Khamosh Kyun Ho Jate Hain?

Maine sabse pehli cheez ye observe ki ke jab insaan apne saamne koi ghalat kaam, jurm ya zulm hota hua dekhta hai, toh kai logon ka pehla reaction use ignore karna hota hai.

Bilkul waise hi jaise hamari class mein hua.

Kuch students khamosh the.

Kuch ne bura bhala kaha.

Lekin har kisi ne action nahi liya.

Yahan mujhe insani psychology ka ek interesting concept samajh aaya.

### The Bystander Effect

Psychology mein **Bystander Effect** ek aisa phenomenon hai jismein kisi emergency ke dauran doosre logon ki maujoodgi kabhi kabhi ek insaan ke madad karne ke chances kam kar deti hai.

Iski ek wajah *Diffusion of Responsibility* hai.

Yaani jab bohot se log kisi incident ko dekh rahe hon, toh individual responsibility ka ehsaas kam ho sakta hai.

Har shakhs ye soch sakta hai ke shayad koi doosra kuch karega.

1968 mein psychologists John Darley aur Bibb Latané ki research ne bhi emergency situations mein responsibility ke is effect ko demonstrate kiya tha.

Ab is concept ko real life se compare karo.

Jab road par koi accident hota hai, toh kabhi logon ka hujoom jama ho jata hai.

Kuch log sirf dekhte rehte hain.

Kuch aapas mein baatein karte hain.

Kuch doosron ke action ka intezar karte hain.

Aur kabhi unhi logon mein se koi ek insaan aage barh kar madad karta hai.

Lekin aisa bhi nahi ke har khamosh insaan beparwah hota hai. Kuch log darr, confusion ya situation ko na samajhne ki wajah se bhi ruk sakte hain.

Phir mujhe ehsaas hua ke ye psychology sirf zulm tak limited nahi.

Zindagi mein jab koi opportunity saamne aati hai, toh hum kabhi kabhi use bhi doosron ke bharose chhor dete hain.

Hum sochte hain ke pehle koi doosra try kare, phir dekhenge.

Lekin aksar initiative wahi leta hai jo doosron ke action ka intezar nahi karta.

**Mera pehla lesson ye tha ke kisi cheez ko ghalat samajhna aur uske khilaaf practical action lena, dono alag cheezein hain.**

Sirf dil mein gussa hona ya kisi ko bura kehna hamesha kaafi nahi hota.

---

# Reality No. 2: College Ki Boundary Aur Society Ki Invisible Boundaries

Is poore incident mein ek cheez ne mujhe sabse zyada sochne par majboor kiya.

**College ki boundary.**

Woh ek physical boundary thi.

Ek deewar, ek darwaza aur kuch rules.

Lekin mere liye woh sirf college ki boundary nahi thi.

Woh mujhe hamari society ki boundaries jaisi lagi.

Hamari class mein kuch students aise the jo bahar jaana chahte the.

Woh us bachay par hone wale zulm ko rokna chahte the.

Lekin college ke rules unhein rok rahe the.

Aur main khud bhi unhi mein se ek tha.

Main jaana chahta tha, lekin pehle ruk gaya.

Socho, ek taraf ek masoom bacha tha jise maara ja raha tha.

Doosri taraf ek rule tha ke bina permission college se bahar nahi ja sakte.

Us waqt mere andar do cheezein ek doosre ke saamne khari thin.

**Ek mera zameer tha, aur doosra mera darr.**

Aur mujhe laga ke society mein bhi hum roz isi tarah ki situations face karte hain.

Kabhi hum koi business shuru karna chahte hain, lekin logon ke reactions se darte hain.

Kabhi apni pasand ka career choose karna chahte hain, lekin family ya society ki expectations humein rok deti hain.

Kabhi kisi ghalat baat ke khilaaf awaaz uthana chahte hain, lekin sochte hain ke doosre kya kahenge.

Yahan har boundary physical nahi hoti.

Kuch boundaries hamare zehan mein hoti hain.

Psychology mein is tarah ke darr ko samajhne ke liye *Evaluation Apprehension* ka concept bhi relevant hai: doosron ki nazar mein apne action ke judge hone ka darr.

Lekin yahan ek important distinction hai.

Har rule ghalat nahi hota.

Rules society ko organize karte hain, discipline aur safety provide karte hain.

Lekin kabhi kabhi aisi exceptional situations aa jati hain jahan humein ye sochna parta hai ke rules follow karne ka maqsad kya hai aur insani zimmedari kya demand karti hai.

Iska matlab ye nahi ke har situation mein rules tor dena chahiye.

Balki ye ke kisi emergency mein insani jaan aur safety ko priority dene ke liye responsible tareeqe se action lena zaroori ho sakta hai.

Us din mujhe samajh aaya ke...

**Kabhi kabhi insaan ko deewar nahi rokti, balki us deewar ke doosri taraf hone wale consequences ka darr rokta hai.**

---

# Reality No. 3: Jab Hamare Bare Khamosh Ho Jayein, Toh Hum Bhi Himmat Haarne Lagte Hain

Is incident ka teesra lesson meri teacher ke reaction se related tha.

Jab humne unhein bataya ke neeche ek aadmi chhote se bachay ko maar raha hai, toh unhone is baat ko ignore kar diya.

Ab main ye nahi jaanta ke unhone aisa kyun kiya.

Ho sakta hai unhein situation ki seriousness samajh nahi aayi ho.

Lekin jo reaction maine dekha, usne mujhe ek aur reality samjha di.

Hum aksar apne baron ke behavior ko dekh kar apne decisions banate hain.

Agar teacher kisi cheez ko serious nahi leta, toh kuch students bhi usay serious lena chhor sakte hain.

Agar parents kisi kaam ko impossible samajhte hain, toh unke bachay bhi kabhi kabhi use try karne se pehle hi haar maan lete hain.

Agar ghar mein koi bara insaan hamesha mushkil kaam se peechay hatta raha ho, toh chhote bhi ye seekh sakte hain ke shayad peechay hatna hi behtar tareeqa hai.

### Social Learning Theory

Psychologist Albert Bandura ki Social Learning Theory ke mutabiq insaan doosron ko observe karke bhi behavior seekh sakta hai.

Hum sirf woh nahi seekhte jo humein bataya jata hai.

Hum woh bhi seekhte hain jo hum apne aas paas hota hua dekhte hain.

Isi liye role models hamari thinking par bohot asar daal sakte hain.

Real life mein iski bohot si examples hain.

Ek bacha apne baap ko logon ki madad karte dekhe, toh woh madad karne ke behavior se seekh sakta hai.

Lekin agar woh hamesha ye dekhe ke ghar ke bare log har mushkil situation mein peechay hat jate hain, toh uski apni thinking bhi isse influence ho sakti hai.

Mujhe laga ke hamari class mein bhi kuch aisa hi ho sakta tha.

Teacher ki khamoshi kuch students ke liye ek signal ban sakti thi ke shayad is mamlay mein kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi.

Lekin yahan mujhe ek aur baat samajh aayi.

**Kisi bare ka kuch na kar pana is baat ka saboot nahi ke hum bhi kuch nahi kar sakte.**

Hamare parents, teachers aur relatives hamare liye important hain.

Unke experiences bhi important hain.

Lekin unki har limitation ko apni permanent limitation bana lena zaroori nahi.

Agar humse pehle kisi ne koi mushkil kaam nahi kiya, toh iska matlab ye nahi ke woh kaam mumkin hi nahi.

**Mera teesra lesson ye tha ke role models se seekhna zaroori hai, lekin apni soch aur faisla karne ki salahiyat ko poori tarah doosron par depend nahi karna chahiye.**

---

# Reality No. 4: Jin Consequences Se Hum Darte Hain, Zaroori Nahi Woh Waqai Hon

Ye mere liye poore incident ka sabse interesting aur powerful lesson tha.

Jab woh larka bina permission college ki boundary cross karke bahar gaya, toh mujhe laga ke wapas aane par sir zaroor daantenge.

Aakhir college ka rule tora gaya tha.

Aur main khud bhi isi darr ki wajah se pehle ruk gaya tha.

Lekin jab woh larka wapas aaya...

Toh kuch bilkul unexpected hua.

Sir ne use daantne ke bajaye kaha:

**"Sirf baat karke aaye ho? Do chaar laga dete us kutte ke bachay ko!"**

Ye sun kar main hairaan reh gaya.

Jis teacher ke reaction ke darr se hum bahar jaane se ruk rahe the, woh khud us aadmi par gussa kar raha tha.

Yahin mujhe ek bohot interesting baat samajh aayi.

**Kabhi kabhi hum haqeeqat se nahi, balki apne zehan mein banaye hue khauf se darr rahe hote hain.**

Hum pehle hi imagine kar lete hain ke agar maine ye kaam kiya toh log kya kahenge.

Agar business shuru kiya aur fail ho gaya toh?

Agar apna idea kisi ko bataya aur usne mazaaq ura diya toh?

Agar maine kisi ghalat baat ke khilaaf awaaz uthayi toh?

Agar family ne support na kiya toh?

Lekin problem ye hai ke hum kabhi kabhi apne imagined consequences ko hi final reality samajh lete hain.

Aur phir koshish karne se pehle hi peechay hat jate hain.

Psychologically, kisi negative outcome ki possibility ko zehan mein rakh kar future se darrna insani behavior ka hissa ho sakta hai.

Lekin possibility aur certainty mein farq hota hai.

Ye farq maine us din khud experience kiya.

Main jis reaction se darr raha tha, woh reaction aaya hi nahi.

Haan, sir ki us aadmi ko maarne wali baat ghusse ka izhar thi. Main ye nahi kehta ke kisi ko peetna sahi solution hota. Violence ke jawab mein violence situation ko aur kharab kar sakti hai.

Lekin mere liye us waqt asal observation teacher ke ghusse se zyada kuch aur thi.

**Maine apne zehan mein ek consequence assume kar liya tha, jo baad mein sach sabit nahi hua.**

Isse mujhe society ki ek aur reality samajh aayi.

Hum aksar kisi kaam ko sirf isliye nahi karte kyunke humein lagta hai ke doosre log humein judge karenge.

Lekin hum ye bhool jate hain ke shayad woh log hamare baare mein waisa soch bhi nahi rahe hote jaisa hum assume kar rahe hain.

Aur kabhi kabhi wohi log humein support bhi kar dete hain.

Is incident mein sabse pehle bahar jaane wala larka hamare muqable mein zyada decisive tha.

Usne jo ghalat dekha, uske khilaaf action liya.

Usne teacher ke possible reaction ka intezar nahi kiya.

Aur wapas aane par use woh punishment bhi nahi mili jiska humein darr tha.

Lekin isse ek lesson aur milta hai:

**Asal bahaduri har boundary ko torna nahi, balki ye samajhna hai ke kab darr hamare faislon ko control kar raha hai aur kab waqai koi risk maujood hai.**

Kamyab hone ke liye independent thinking zaroori hai.

Lekin independent thinking ka matlab sirf dil ki sunna nahi.

Apne decisions ke consequences samajhna bhi utna hi zaroori hai.

---

# Reality No. 5: Log Pehle Rokte Hain, Phir Result Dekh Kar Hairaan Hote Hain

Is incident ki ek aur interesting baat thi.

Jab woh larka bahar ja raha tha, toh ek student use rok raha tha.

Woh keh raha tha ke bahar na jao.

Lekin jab wahi larka bahar se wapas aaya, toh use rokne wala student khud pooch raha tha:

**"Kya kaha usne? Kyun maar raha tha?"**

Main uske reaction ko observe kar raha tha.

Pehle woh use bahar jaane se rok raha tha.

Lekin ab woh khud jaana chahta tha ke bahar kya hua aur kya result nikla.

Yahan mujhe real life ki ek aur interesting reality nazar aayi.

**Kuch log khud risk nahi lena chahte, lekin doosron ke risk lene ka result zaroor dekhna chahte hain.**

Iska matlab ye nahi ke har rokne wala insaan ghalat hota hai.

Kabhi log genuine concern ki wajah se bhi rokte hain.

Lekin ye behavior hamari rozmarra ki zindagi mein bhi dekhne ko milta hai.

Misaal ke taur par parents ko hi dekh lo.

Jab hum koi mushkil ya risky kaam karna chahte hain, toh aksar woh humein rokte hain.

Unhein darr hota hai ke kahin hum fail na ho jayein.

Kahin koi nuqsan na ho jaye.

Kahin hamara waqt ya paisa zaya na ho jaye.

Lekin agar hum woh kaam kar lein aur result acha nikle, toh kabhi wohi log hamari tareef karte hain.

**"Shabash! Bohot acha kiya."**

Aur agar result bura nikle toh?

**"Humne tumhein pehle hi roka tha na!"**

Yaani ek hi decision ko log kabhi kabhi uske final result ke mutabiq judge karte hain.

Psychology mein is tarah ki thinking ko *Outcome Bias* se compare kiya ja sakta hai.

Outcome Bias mein hum kisi decision ki quality ko sirf uske final result ki bunyaad par judge karne lagte hain, bajaye iske ke decision lete waqt available information, risk aur reasoning ko bhi samjhein.

Lekin kya har successful result ka matlab hai ke decision sahi tha?

Aur kya har failure ka matlab hai ke decision ghalat tha?

Zaroori nahi.

Kabhi ek acha decision bhi buri situation ki wajah se fail ho sakta hai.

Aur kabhi ek risky ya ghalat decision bhi luck ki wajah se acha result de sakta hai.

Isi liye main samajhta hoon ke humein sirf outcome nahi, balki decision lene ki reasoning bhi dekhni chahiye.

Us student ne bahar jaane se kyun roka tha, ye main yaqeen se nahi keh sakta.

Ho sakta hai woh rules ki wajah se darr raha ho.

Ho sakta hai use punishment ka khauf ho.

Ya shayad woh sirf unnecessary risk nahi lena chahta tha.

Lekin uske badalte hue reaction ne mujhe ye zaroor samjha diya ke...

**Jo kaam karne se hum pehle darte hain, kabhi kabhi kisi doosre ko wahi kaam karte dekh kar uska result jaanne ke liye curious ho jate hain.**

Aur isse maine seekha ke zindagi ke bade decisions mein sirf doosron ke darr ko apna darr nahi bana lena chahiye.

Unki baat sunni chahiye.

Unke concerns ko samajhna chahiye.

Lekin aakhir mein situation ko khud bhi evaluate karna chahiye.

---

# Ek Aur Baat: Kya Baap Hone Se Kisi Ko Bachay Par Zulm Karne Ka Haq Mil Jata Hai?

Is poore incident mein ek sawaal mere zehan mein reh gaya.

**Woh aadmi waqai us bachay ka baap tha ya nahi?**

Hum ye confirm nahi kar sake.

Lekin phir maine socha...

Agar woh uska baap tha bhi, toh kya isse usay ek 3–4 saal ke bachay ko itni buri tarah maarne ka haq mil jata hai?

Yahan ek legal aur psychological reality samajhna zaroori hai.

Pakistan Penal Code ki **Section 328-A** bachon ke saath aisi cruelty ko address karti hai jismein jaan boojh kar assault, ill-treatment ya koi aisa amal shamil ho jo bachay ko physical ya psychological injury pohanchaye ya uska sabab ban sakta ho. Kisi specific waqiye par is law ka application evidence aur legal assessment par depend karta hai.

Aur science bhi bachon ko physical punishment dene ke nuqsanat ko highlight karti hai.

World Health Organization ke mutabiq corporal punishment bachon ki physical aur mental health ko nuqsan pohancha sakti hai. Iska talluq aggression, emotional problems aur development par negative effects se bhi paya gaya hai.

Mujhe us bachay ka rona aur uska dara hua hona yaad tha.

Woh itna chhota tha ke shayad apni baat bhi theek tarah explain nahi kar sakta tha.

Aur yahi cheez mujhe sabse zyada disturb kar rahi thi.

**Jab koi insaan apne liye awaaz nahi utha sakta, toh uski hifazat ki zimmedari aur bhi important ho jati hai.**

Mera maqsad ye nahi ke har parent ko ghalat samjha jaye.

Lekin discipline aur violence mein farq hota hai.

Bachay ko samjhana alag cheez hai.

Aur use itna maarna ke woh neeche mitti mein gir jaye, bilkul alag.

Us din mujhe ye bhi samajh aaya ke kisi ko protect karne ke liye sirf gussa kaafi nahi hota.

Samajhdari se action lena, responsible logon ko involve karna aur zaroorat par authorities tak baat pohanchana bhi important hota hai.

Punjab mein child protection ke liye **1121** aur police emergency ke liye **15** jaisi services maujood hain.

---

# Final Realization: Us Din Maine Sirf Ek Waqia Nahi, Apni Society Ko Dekha

Aaj jab main is poore incident ko yaad karta hoon, toh mujhe lagta hai ke hamari class kisi had tak society ki ek chhoti si representation thi.

Ek taraf woh log the jo sab kuch dekh kar bhi khamosh rahe.

Doosri taraf woh the jo gussa toh kar rahe the, lekin action nahi le rahe the.

Phir woh log the jo kuch karna chahte the, magar rules aur consequences ke darr se ruk gaye.

Aur phir ek larka tha jo sabse pehle utha aur bahar chala gaya.

Main khud bhi pehle ruk gaya tha.

Lekin phir main bhi gaya.

Isliye main apne aap ko us incident ka hero nahi samajhta.

Main bhi usi society ka hissa tha jise main observe kar raha tha.

Mere andar bhi darr tha.

Mere zehan mein bhi rules the.

Main bhi consequences ke baare mein soch raha tha.

Bas farq ye tha ke us waqt maine apne aas paas ke reactions ko observe kiya, aur baad mein unhein apni real life se compare karna shuru kar diya.

Mujhe laga ke zindagi mein hum kai martaba isi tarah ki situations face karte hain.

Kabhi humein kisi ki madad karni hoti hai.

Kabhi sach bolna hota hai.

Kabhi koi opportunity leni hoti hai.

Kabhi apne future ke liye ek mushkil decision lena hota hai.

Aur har dafa hamare saamne do cheezein hoti hain:

**Ek woh jo hum karna chahte hain.**

**Aur doosri woh jisse hum darte hain.**

Lekin ab main ye bhi samajhta hoon ke har darr bekaar nahi hota.

Kabhi darr humein unnecessary danger se bachata hai.

Aur kabhi wahi darr humein woh kaam karne se rok deta hai jo humein karna chahiye.

Asal challenge in dono mein farq samajhna hai.

Us din mere liye college ki boundary sirf ek deewar thi.

Lekin us incident ne mujhe sochne par majboor kar diya ke insaan ki zindagi mein kitni aisi invisible boundaries hoti hain jinhein woh khud apne zehan mein bana leta hai.

Kabhi society ki wajah se.

Kabhi parents ki expectations ki wajah se.

Kabhi teachers ya authority ke darr se.

Aur kabhi sirf isliye ke humein nahi pata hota ke doosri taraf kya hoga.

### Lekin is sab ke baad ek sawaal reh jata hai...

Jab woh masoom bacha maar kha raha tha, toh hum sab ek hi manzar dekh rahe the.

Phir bhi hamare reactions itne mukhtalif kyun the?

Kisi ne ignore kiya.

Kisi ko gussa aaya.

Koi darr gaya.

Koi aage barh gaya.

**Manzar ek tha. Log bhi usi society ka hissa the. Lekin unke faisle alag the.**

Shayad isliye ke har insaan ka darr, uski soch, uske experiences aur uski priorities alag hoti hain.

Aur yahin mujhe zindagi ka ek important lesson mila:

**"Har insaan ghalat ko ghalat keh sakta hai, lekin har insaan uske khilaaf khara nahi hota. Aur har woh shakhs jo foran khara nahi hota, zaroori nahi ke woh ghalat ko sahi samajhta ho."**

Isliye kisi ke ek reaction se uski poori personality ka faisla karna bhi theek nahi.

Lekin apne reaction ko samajhna zaroori hai.

Kyunke agar hum ye samajh jayein ke humein kis cheez ne roka tha, toh shayad agli baar hum behtar decision le sakein.

Aur mere liye is poore incident ka sabse important lesson yahi hai:

**Himmat ka matlab ye nahi ke insaan ko darr nahi lagta. Himmat ka matlab hai ke insaan apne darr ko samjhe, situation ki seriousness ko pehchane, aur phir woh action le jo sahi bhi ho aur zimmedarana bhi.**

### Aakhri Baat

Us din ek larka khirki se bahar dekh raha tha.

Usne neeche ek bachay ko pitte hue dekha.

Aur hum sab ne bhi woh manzar dekh liya.

Lekin mere liye woh khirki sirf college ke bahar ka manzar nahi dikha rahi thi.

**Woh mujhe insani rawaiyon aur apni society ka ek aisa pehlu dikha rahi thi, jiske baare mein shayad main pehle itni gehrai se kabhi nahi socha tha.**

Aur shayad isi liye kuch waqiat sirf yaadein nahi bante...

**Woh hamare sochne ka tareeqa badal dete hain.**
